name: HC24: Malnourished
description: Active ART clients classified as malnourished during the reporting quarter. Includes underweight, moderate acute malnutrition, and severe acute malnutrition.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson: {"version":1,"themeUuid":"fce32056-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9","conditions":[],"sqlPreview":"WITH active_art_clients AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card WHERE encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate), latest_nutrition AS (SELECT client_id, nutrition_assesment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY encounter_date DESC) as rn FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card WHERE encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND nutrition_assesment IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT aac.client_id AS patient_id FROM active_art_clients aac INNER JOIN latest_nutrition ln ON aac.client_id = ln.client_id AND ln.rn = 1 WHERE ln.nutrition_assesment IN (\"UNDERWEIGHT\", \"MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION\", \"SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION\", \"SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA\")","themeConfig":{"sourceTable":"mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card","patientIdColumn":"client_id","dateColumn":"encounter_date","fields":[{"key":"client","expr":"client_id","type":"number","label":"Client"},{"key":"nutrition_assesment","expr":"nutrition_assesment","type":"coded","label":"Nutrition Assessment"}],"conditions":[{"key":"encounter_date","label":"Encounter Date Range","column":"encounter_date","handler":"DATE_RANGE","operator":"BETWEEN","valueType":"date"},{"key":"malnutrition_status","label":"Malnutrition Status","column":"nutrition_assesment","handler":"IN","operator":"IN","valueType":"coded","options":["UNDERWEIGHT","MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION","SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION","SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA"]}]}}
sqlTemplate:
WITH active_art_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order
        WHERE is_active_on_art = 1
          AND coverage_start_date <= :endDate
          AND (coverage_end_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY OR coverage_end_date IS NULL)
        UNION
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_return_date
        WHERE return_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND return_date <= :endDate
    ) as potential_active
    WHERE client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
        WHERE transfer_out_date IS NOT NULL AND transfer_out_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT person_id FROM person
        WHERE dead = 1 AND death_date <= :endDate
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT arv.client_id) AS total
FROM active_art_base base
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order arv ON base.client_id = arv.client_id
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_nutrition_assesment na ON arv.client_id = na.client_id
WHERE na.status IN ("UNDERWEIGHT", "MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION", "SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION", "SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA")
